scenario.figure_or_table: Table III (experimental setup) and Table IV (simulation results), Section IV-A
scenario.description: Selected scenario: the 2-D 256-core SCC-based processor simulated in PACT and HotSpot for speed analysis. The text gives a hot-spot power density of 216.6 W/cm2 and the same medium-cost heat sink in both tools. Table III and Table IV are image content and were not extracted as text. Block geometry (x_m, y_m, width_m, height_m) and per-block power rows are not available in the extracted text, so no complete floorplan can be recorded from this packet. The packet contains no linked asset text for the repository, so its contents are unverified. No paper thermal observable for this specific scenario (temperature in degC) can be cited from the text; the reported results are simulation times and speedups (up to 1.9x steady-state and 232x transient over HotSpot).
scenario.architecture: 256-core 2-D processor inspired by the Intel SCC scaled to 22 nm, with IA-32 cores; medium-cost heat spreader and heat sink model (HotSpot-style) in PACT
scenario.workload: Simulated power profile of the SCC-based chip from Eris et al. (ref [20]), selected as the profile with the highest thermal gradient and chip temperature; hot spot power density 216.6 W/cm2; total chip power not stated in extracted text
scenario.operating_point: Steady-state (and transient) thermal simulation at standard-cell/architecture grid resolutions listed in Table III (not extracted); PACT on Xyce 6.12 with OpenMPI 3.1.4, up to 112 cores; solver, grid size and heat sink parameters per Table III (values not available in extracted text)

original_setup.solver: PACT (SPICE-based parallel compact thermal simulator) run on the Xyce 6.12 engine with OpenMPI 3.1.4, up to 112 cores. Steady-state solvers are KLU and AztecOO, and the transient solver is TRAP (a hybrid of backward Euler and trapezoidal). The comparison baseline is HotSpot with the same medium-cost heat sink. The exact solver, grid and heat-sink settings for this scenario are in Table III, which was not extracted (PDF page 8).
original_setup.optimizer: None. This is a thermal-simulation speed comparison with no design optimizer.
original_setup.controller: None. No runtime thermal controller is used in this scenario.
original_setup.benchmark: 2-D 256-core processor inspired by the Intel SCC and scaled to 22 nm, with IA-32 cores. The power profile comes from the Eris et al. simulation (ref [20]), chosen for the highest thermal gradient and chip temperature, with a hot-spot power density of 216.6 W/cm2. It is simulated in PACT versus HotSpot for speed (Tables III and IV, Section IV-A, PDF page 8). Reported speedups over HotSpot are up to 1.9x steady-state and 232x transient.

physical_mismatches.reason: No complete floorplan is available for this scenario. Block x/y/width/height and per-block power rows are in image-only tables or figures that were not extracted. Total chip power is not stated, and the packet gives no rule for splitting it. No same-scenario geometry and power can be assembled.

The paper reports simulation time and speedup for this scenario, not a temperature observable. No temperature value, unit, location or aggregation can be cited from the extracted text, so the thermal observable cannot be compared with a Studio result.

The original solver is a parallel SPICE-based compact RC network (Xyce, OpenMPI, KLU/AztecOO/TRAP) at standard-cell or architecture grid resolutions. A different solver or discretization in a Studio package would not reproduce the paper's speed or accuracy results.

The original uses a HotSpot-style medium-cost heat spreader and heat sink with air convection. Its parameters are in Table III, which was not extracted. A different cooling stack in Studio would change absolute temperatures.

The scenario is 2-D, so there is no 3-D or interposer mismatch. The paper has no optimizer or controller in this scenario, and no reliability analysis. The paper's 3-D (monolithic), liquid-microchannel and PNoC/interposer experiments are separate scenarios and are not part of this selection.
